description: Na₂Ba₆Si₄O₁₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.60 Å. There are three inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.06 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-3.04 Å. In the third Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.70-3.22 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-40°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-16°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to four Ba and two equivalent Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, three Ba, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Ba and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Ba, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one Si atom.
